endpoints.note: §33: the two digests the capture wrote itself. This table recomputes neither, because recomputing one would need the URL it replaced.

identity_fields.frame_index: ABSENT — no index / sequence / slot / payloadId key appears in any read, so the frame index is assigned locally from read order (§8)
identity_fields.height: number — a hex quantity, present in every read
identity_fields.state_credential: stateRoot — an all-zero placeholder in every distinct view of both windows
identity_fields.view_hash: hash — changes between reads of one height, so identity is never the hash alone

kind: characterization from the committed raw lines (§5.1/§6)
what_was_not_probed_here: node version / commit — the endpoint publishes no field naming it (§52: UNKNOWN, not guessed)
upstream Flashblocks vs Subblocks evolution — a repository question, answered in the audit, not by these two windows
storage / balance / logs at the pending tag — audit §2.2 already ruled the pending view out as a state credential; this milestone reads no state
wire_format_notes: a pending answer is one complete block object: no envelope, no notification method, no subscription id, nothing to frame a stream with
the same height is answered repeatedly and each answer is a longer list of the same transactions, so a frame is a snapshot of one growing view rather than a delta

the header names the sequencer as miner and carries the OP-Stack fields (blobGasUsed, excessBlobGas, requestsHash, withdrawalsRoot), which is what identifies this endpoint's product family without a version string the endpoint does not publish
